newsitem.title: USA: Tremont sees profitable second half 1997.
newsitem.headline: Tremont sees profitable second half 1997.

text.p: Tremont Corp said on Tuesday it expects to continue to be profitable in the second half of 1997.
Tremont, a holding company with operations in the titanium metals business and other businesses, said that, based on current trends, it expects to be profitable over the remainder of the year.

Tremont reported second-quarter earnings of $0.62 per share, compared to $3.14 for the same period a year ago. The year-ago period included a one-time gain of $26.6 million from the sale of TIMET stock, the company said.
